description.text: Grants [Attach Water with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Lion], [Apex Walk the Plank Ability Tracker] and [Apex Walk the Plank Level]

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Lion
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Walk the Plank (0~2), removed after using Apex Walk the Plank two times

description.name: Apex Walk the Plank Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Walk the Plank level by 1 after using 5 or 8 Water abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Lion]

description.name: Apex Walk the Plank Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Walk the Plank level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Lion]
